$comment: Accepted dependency advisories for the gate 11 audit (infra/security/src/audit.ts). Each entry names the advisory, the package it was accepted for, why, and the date by which it is reviewed again; an entry past its review_by date fails the audit until someone reviews it and moves the date. Remove an entry once the advisory no longer appears. The audit fails on any production advisory and on any critical advisory anywhere in the tree (malware advisories are critical).

advisories.reason: No patched release exists (vulnerable <=1.4.0). It comes with the Expo command line tool that builds and serves Compass; the Compass app bundle does not include @expo/cli. Accepted 2026-10-19 (A54, gate 11).

No patched release exists (vulnerable <=3.0.3). It comes with Metro, the bundler that builds Compass, which expands only the repository's own glob patterns; the Compass app bundle does not include it. Accepted 2026-10-19 (A54, gate 11).

The fix, 0.5.0, is ESM only, and query-string 7 under expo-router requires it from CommonJS, so it cannot be applied as an override. The worst case is a stalled Compass screen on the device that opens a malformed link (denial of service, no data exposure). Review when expo-router moves to a query-string that accepts 0.5.0. Accepted 2026-10-19 (A54, gate 11).
